evaluation_design: exploratory in-sample direct-recording smoke set; not held out
ground_truth_status: dataset-associated IDs; not independently or manually confirmed

metadata_baseline.denominator_policy: all eligible cases; failed or empty rankings contribute zero

text_only.denominator_policy: all eligible cases; failed or empty rankings contribute zero

audio_only.denominator_policy: all eligible cases; failed or empty rankings contribute zero

multimodal.denominator_policy: all eligible cases; failed or empty rankings contribute zero

text_engine_initialization_error: Text engine initialization explicitly skipped by operator.

configuration.audio_features: 22.05 kHz mono; 20 MFCC-like + 12 chroma means/std; cosine similarity
configuration.fusion: weighted reciprocal rank fusion; text 0.6, audio 0.4, rrf_constant 60
configuration.metadata_baseline: case-insensitive alphanumeric substring match against title, singer, raga, tala; deterministic hit-count/length/ID tie-break

limitations: Each query recording is already part of the indexed set; identity retrieval is expected and is not cross-performance evidence.
The dataset does not provide an independent held-out query set or independently verified relevance judgments.
Failures and empty rankings contribute zero to all aggregate metrics; denominator is all eligible cases.
No weights or thresholds were tuned against a held-out set; all generated cases are explicitly marked as tuning/in-sample.
